terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
terms.intro_text: By registering and using CoverCraft, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. This platform allows you to generate and manage cover letters using artificial intelligence.
terms.data_text: When using our services, we process your CV data and job descriptions using Artificial Intelligence models (e.g., Google Gemini via n8n) exclusively to generate cover letters. We keep your document history on secure servers (Supabase) but we do not use your confidential information to train our models.
terms.account_text: You are responsible for keeping your password secret. You are free to delete both uploaded CVs and generated letters at any time from your Dashboard. Upon deletion, documents are permanently removed from our servers.
terms.changes_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms in the future. You can always check the most updated version on this page.
